validity.researcher_notes: The sheet currently carries StartState/Province='West Virginia', StartPrefecture/District='Marshall County' (worklist Location cluster). Neither of the row's own two independent, verified sources supports this. The Reuters wire (2019-02-12) states FERC approved putting part of Gulf XPress 'into service in Kentucky, Mississippi and Tennessee' and that 'the...Gulf XPress project includes construction of seven new compressor stations in Kentucky, Tennessee and Mississippi.' TC Energy's own release (2019-03-01) states partial in-service 'includes placing into service four new compressor stations located in Kentucky, Tennessee and Mississippi' adding capacity 'on the Columbia Gulf Transmission System.' Neither source ever mentions West Virginia, Marshall County, or Cabell County in connection with Gulf Xpress's own construction footprint -- West Virginia appears in both articles only in the context of (a) the Marcellus/Utica SUPPLY basin feeding the broader Appalachian takeaway buildout generally, and (b) the separate, paired Mountaineer XPress project (which IS a genuine new-build pipeline within West Virginia). Both articles were published/announced jointly covering MXP and GXP together ('TransCanada's Mountaineer XPress project placed into service, Gulf XPress reaches partial in-service'), which is a plausible mechanism for a West Virginia/Marshall County value to have been cross-contaminated onto the Gulf Xpress row from its sibling Mountaineer XPress row (P0221, a genuine WV project). For transparency: gem.wiki's own (uncitable) infobox text asserts 'The pipeline will run through Marshall and Cabell counties, West Virginia' and labels Length as 'Reversal' -- this GEM-authored claim is itself unsupported by any of the row's own cited sources and is the likely origin of the current StartState/StartPrefecture values, not independent confirmation of them.
